newsitem.title: UK: BA rises more on American deal hopes.
newsitem.headline: BA rises more on American deal hopes.

text.p: Shares in British Airways rose over two percent on Tuesday as investors continued to pump funds into the stock on hopes for the carrier's proposed tie-up with American Airlines.
British Airways shares were up 11p at 593p by 1240 GMT while the overall market was only slightly higher. Some 3.7 million shares had changed hands.

"The stock is still rising on speculation about the American Airlines deal and the value of its Heathrow slots and a few people are worried about being short of BA if and when the deal goes through," one marketmaker said.
That was echoed by a second marketmaker.
"There is more confidence about the American deal actually being approved and we're seeing quite a big bear squeeze in the stock," he said.
British Airways stock this year hit a high of 617p, driven by hopes for the American Airlines deal.
